caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular metal lantern with a handle on top and a looped wire for carrying. The lantern is primarily rendered in shades of brown, gray, and black, with metal framing and clear glass panels on all visible sides. The corners of the lantern are reinforced with darker metal strips, and there are diagonal metal supports in the front, forming an "X" shape across the central glass panel. Inside the lantern, positioned vertically and centered, is a yellowish-green candle with a black wick. The background of the composition is a plain, off-white color, and there is a subtle shadow below the lantern, suggesting it is resting on a flat surface.
title: Lantern for Candle
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
